name: image:neo4j
reason: CalVer release matched with the APOC/GDS plugin versions scripts/download-neo4j-plugins.sh pulls; a neo4j bump must land together with a plugin bump, not on its own. "2026.09.0" is neo4j's own explicit-patch alias for the exact same release as "2026.09" (not a newer one) — the registry lists both tags for one image digest.

reason: Major PostgreSQL versions require an explicit migration; the 18 -> 18.1 minor bump is safe but deliberately deferred until that migration work is scheduled.
